chunks: So We sent Moses with Our signs after them to Pharaoh and his nobles, but they behaved with them high-handedly. See then the end of the authors of evil.
ai.seo_question: What happened to Pharaoh and his nobles after rejecting Moses' miracles?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the pattern of divine patience followed by decisive retribution, where Pharaoh's elite not only rejected Moses' miracles but actively distorted the truth, embodying the archetype of *zulm* (injustice). The rhetorical conclusion serves as a timeless warning to the *Ummah* that the fate of corrupt rulers is sealed by their own arrogance, a theme frequently cited in sermons of Imam Ali (AS) regarding the fall of tyrants.
